channel.title: Vikram Kamble's Blog
channel.description: Posts about web development, backend engineering, and the decisions behind them - written from shipping real projects.

item.title: Trying to Build a Local Large File Upload Tracker
item.dc:creator: Vikram Kamble
item.description: Chunked upload for 1-2 GB files in Node: 5MB chunks, Express + multer, resume, retries, progress, and stitching with a writeStream drain so files stay intact.

item.title: I Tried to Beat Node.js with C++. It Didn't Go as Expected.
item.dc:creator: Vikram Kamble
item.description: C++ vs Node.js HTTP benchmark with wrk: Crow 5.4k req/s, Node http 12k, uWebSockets 57k. Same route, same laptop, with code and why Crow lost to Node.

item.title: Building With the Gemini API: The Part the Docs Don't Cover
item.dc:creator: Vikram Kamble
item.description: Why the Gemini API returns an empty response with status 200 (finishReason SAFETY, MAX_TOKENS), how to read real 400/429 error bodies, and what to send it.

item.title: SQL vs NoSQL: I've Shipped Both, Here's How I Actually Decide
item.dc:creator: Vikram Kamble
item.description: When to use SQL vs NoSQL, from shipping real apps on MySQL and MongoDB: the actual trade-offs, code examples, common misconceptions, and a decision flowchart.

item.title: Library vs Framework: The Real Difference Every Developer Should Know
item.dc:creator: Vikram Kamble
item.description: The difference between a library and a framework is inversion of control. Explained with React vs Next.js code, a comparison table and a cooking analogy.
